text:
Lina (People Ops): quick ping — putting together a one-paragraph manager "cheat sheet" + a day-7 signoff checklist for new hires. Wanted the version to be extremely short so managers can paste into Slack or Notion without edits. Thoughts?

Lina (People Ops): DRAFT (copy/paste):
Hi {{name}}, welcome to Redwood! Im {{manager}}. Quick plan: Day 0: confirm Okta invite & MFA, accept device, open access form. Day 1: 09:00 intro (10m), 09:15 setup check (15m), 10:00 product & immediate task (45m). Week 1: pair on first PR, meet People Ops (30m), join team syncs. Day-7 manager signoff: confirm Console access green, first PR/doc merged, 30/60/90 draft created, 30d feedback scheduled. Who to ping: IT @Sam (devices/Okta/VPN), DevEx @DevEx (repos/CI), Security @sec-team (KMS), HR @Jordan (payroll/benefits). Links: access form: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request, create ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?labels=access-onboard

Avery (Eng Manager): Love terse format. Please add a 15m note for oncall if role touches infra and a one-liner about how to escalate blocked access ("DM @Sam or escalate with #access-urgent").

Sam (IT): I'll wire Day 0 automation so Okta + laptop imaging triggers when HR form includes #onboard. I can also add a one-click access-ticket button in the Notion page.

Jordan (HR): Add "benefits enrollment within 30 days" and probation check cadence at 30/60 in the Notion template. Also we do a People Ops welcome in week 1 (30m) 12.

Lina (People Ops): Can someone own the buddy roster for Eng? Need a contact to assign buddies quickly.

Avery (Eng Manager): I can take Eng buddy roster this quarter and post a rota in #eng by EOD tomorrow.

BuddyBot: Reminder set: "Publish manager cheat sheet to Notion" in 48 hours.

Lina (People Ops): thanks all. once Notion is live i'll drop a tiny Slack intro snippet managers can paste: "Please welcome {{name}} as {{role}}. Buddy: {{buddy}}. First week priorities: ..."

Sam (IT): FYI, access tickets auto-created when HR form has #onboard. Link to form again: https://forms.redwood.com/onboard-request

(End thread)
